SINDH
ARMS (AMDNDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Sindh
Arms Act, 2013
[Gazette
of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd March, 2017]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-03/2017, dated
22.3.2017.---The Sindh Arms (Amendment)
Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 02nd February, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 10th March, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---AND
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Arms Act,
2013, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and Commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Sindh Arms (Amendment)
Act, 2017.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 8 of Sindh Act No. V of 2013

on 10th March, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---AND
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Arms Act,
2013, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 8 of Sindh Act No. V of 2013.---In the Sindh Arms Act, 2013 in section 8, in subsection (1), in
clause (ii), the following proviso shall be added:-
Provided that the conditions of permanent
resident of Province of Sindh shall not be applicable
to the personnel of Armed Services and Civil Armed Forces, employees of Federal
Government, autonomous bodies or corporations, Directors or Senior Management
of Public and Private Limited Companies and tax payers (paying income tax not
less than five hundred thousand rupees in the last financial year), posted or
working in the Province of Sindh. .
